Type: semi-flush glass ceiling lamp
Use: general ceiling light; living room, bedroom, dining room, hallway
Style: industrial, farmhouse, contemporary
Materials: clear glass bowl shade, oil-rubbed bronze metal, exposed filament bulb
Colors: clear, dark bronze black, warm amber glow
Shape: wide rounded drum of clear glass held by three curved arms from a round canopy, visible bulb in a short socket, medium size, light and open
Feel: airy, warm, vintage
Goes with: wood tones, white or grey walls, black hardware; farmhouse, industrial or transitional rooms

The painted steel mount features elegant curved rods, supporting a clear glass ring to amplify the clean, light from within. 14"W x 14"D x 7.25"H Painted steel light, clear glass Semiflush light, mid-century meets contemporary style Bulb included Professional installation recommended For indoor use only
